description: Set up ChatGPT Ads conversion reporting (server-side Conversions API, no browser pixel): creates in the ad account a conversion source, a Conversions API key (stored in the vault as conversions_api_key) and event settings for lead_created, appointment_scheduled and order_created (30-day window), stores pixel_id and the ids in the openai_ads integration, then sends one validate_only test event (checked by OpenAI, not saved). Re-running only creates what is missing. Afterwards report_ad_conversion really sends for leads with ad_source openai_ads and marketing consent. Company integration: admins or whoever may manage openai_ads.

test_only.description: Only send the validate_only test event with the stored setup.

name: setup_chatgpt_ads_conversions
